t48-rf2.setup: Standard DIP24 RF2 placement according to T48 device diagram. Read VCC/VPP 5 V; programming VPP 23.5–25.5 V. Native M2716 read/verify is excluded.

willem-2732a-21v.setup: PCB5.0E tested PCB3B mode: J9/J10 toward DB25; special 2732 routing; DIP ON 7,8,9 only. DIP24 pin 1 at ZIF5, notch toward lever. VCC 5 V; measured VPP 21 V. Only qualified 21 V/50 ms 2732A parts.

willem-2716-read.setup: J9/J10 toward DB25; special 2716 routing, both shunts ZIF-side; DIP ON 1,2,6,8,9. Pin1 at ZIF5, notch toward lever. VCC 5 V, read VPP=VCC.

willem-2764-read.setup: J9/J10 toward DB25; Normal 28-pin routing; DIP ON 1,2,4,6,9. Pin1 at ZIF3, notch toward lever. VCC 5 V; programming VPP off.

willem-27512-read.setup: J9/J10 toward DB25; Normal 28-pin routing; DIP ON 3,5,7,8,9. Pin1 at ZIF3, notch toward lever. VCC 5 V; programming VPP off.
